digest.component_or_area: reconciler invariant check — outbound comment ID recording
propositions: Outbound Jira comment posts succeed but returned comment IDs are not recorded locally, leaving comment_ids count unchanged while post count increases
The reconciler must detect this divergence only after it is observed in 2 consecutive reconcile passes (debounced N=2), not per-pass immediately
Every successful comment post must be tallied at the shared _record_comment_id seam regardless of whether ID recording succeeds
A bridge alert record with deduped key 'bridge-alert:comment-id-divergence' must be appended to bridge_state/bridge_alerts when divergence is confirmed across 2 consecutive passes
Divergence state and debounce counter persist across passes in bridge_state/comment_id_divergence.json and reset when a healthy pass (posts recorded or no posts) is observed
Corrupt or absent state files fail open to counter 0 without disrupting the reconcile pass
